read.en: SanDisk fell 22.3% on Nov 5 to $806.43, trading between $803.97 and $967.99 on heavy volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($1,039.3), 10-day ($1,173.0), 30-day ($1,429.6) and 100-day ($1,570.8) averages and the rising 200-day ($1,270.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($1,354.57), and RSI is 24, oversold.
read.zh: 闪迪 11月5日下跌 22.3%，收于 $806.43，盘中区间 $803.97–967.99，成交量明显放大。股价位于下行的 5 日（$1,039.3）、10 日（$1,173.0）、30 日（$1,429.6）和 100 日均线（$1,570.8）以及上行的 200 日均线（$1,270.5）下方。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线下方，处于零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$1,354.57），RSI 为 24，处于超卖区。

read.en: The drop broke the $998–1,014.5, $980.3 and $926–947 supports, all now resistance, and left a gap from $968 to $1,014. The close sits on the Apr 9 low ($805). Resistance is $851.6–855 (Apr 9 close and high), then $926–947 and $980–1,014. Support is $804–805, then $758.2 (Apr 8 low) and $680–692 (March lows). A close above $855 would target $926–947; below $804, $758.
